marks.gloss_en: רב פפא אמר: אף מהאי נמי -- 'and I will put My spirit within you' (Ezek 36:27)
Rav Pappa: also from this: 'and I will put My spirit within you...' (Ezek 36:27)
מתיב רב ששת: אי הכי, היינו דכתיב ויאמר אלי אלה הקרנות אשר זרו את יהודה -- הני לשובה אתו!
'the Lord showed me four craftsmen' (Zech 2:3) -- Mashiach ben David, Mashiach ben Yosef, Elijah, and the righteous priest
שפיל לסיפיה דקרא: ויבאו אלה להחריד אותם לידות את קרנות הגוים (= p_sofei_dekra) -- the craftsmen come against the horns
go down to the end of the verse: 'these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up a horn against the land of Judah to scatter it' (Zech 2:4)
as it is said: 'only evil all the day' (Gen 6:5)
if this repulsive one meets you, drag it to the study hall
the evil inclination incites a person in this world and testifies against him in the world to come
Rav Huna set 'a spirit of harlotry led them astray' (Hos 4:12) against '[a spirit of harlotry] is within them' (Hos 5:4): at first it leads them astray, in the end it is within them
Rava: at first it is called a traveller, then a guest, and at last a man [of the house]
R' Yochanan: a man has a small organ; starve it and it is sated, sate it and it is hungry
four things God regrets having created: exile, the Chaldeans, the Ishmaelites, and the evil inclination
the Ishmaelites -- 'the tents of robbers are at ease... whom God brought into His hand' (Job 12:6)

R' Yochanan: were it not for these three verses -- 'and her whom I have harmed' (Mic 4:6), 'as clay in the potter's hand' (Jer 18:6), 'I will remove the heart of stone' (Ezek 36:26) -- the feet of 'the enemies of Israel' would have given way
who are the seven shepherds (Mic 5:4)? David in the middle; Adam, Seth and Methuselah on his right; Abraham, Jacob and Moses on his left
תא שמע: ובידיהם כדי שמן של שלשים שלשים לוג, שהם כולם מאה ועשרים לוג -- thirty each, four youths, 120 in all
it was taught: the height of the lamp is fifty amot
it was taught: and they [the youths of the priestly novices] were superior to the son of Marta bat Baitos
(entertained) they were superior because of the weight [they carried]
